t.zh: 目标的结构不止一种：补充对「或者」有效，对「若…则…」失败；假设框正好相反。新元件<part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>：每个框收到同一个状态，送出第一个没有失败的框的结果。
t.en: Goals come in more than one shape: Add alternative works on an “or” and fails on an “if … then …”; the assumption box the other way round. A new part, <part-ref to="part:append"></part-ref>: every region gets the same state, and the result is that of the first region that did not fail.

after.zh: 策略只能调用核的规则，组合得再复杂，也造不出假定理：这是<wiki-ref to="lcf"></wiki-ref>的设计。
after.en: A tactic can only call the kernel’s rules, so however it is combined it cannot make a false theorem: the design of <wiki-ref to="lcf"></wiki-ref>.
